note: The Warrens' people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (The Warrens): Elder Grikkis gives the first two, Packleader Yarrk beside him the three hunts; Stitcher Vikka (west of the elder) is the outfitter, Coachman Drekk keeps the stable south of the elder. The tunnel beetles are at the warren's west end, where the walls give way to the hillside, the deepway millipedes in the south tunnels, the scythe beetle Gravelmaw alone in the far chamber past them.

L1.name: A Pup's Digging Sash
offer: Yip! A new pup in the warren, and its paws still clean. Every digger of clan Kolbok ties on a sash before it lifts a claw, so the pack knows it in the dark.
Stitcher Vikka sews them from tunnel-rat hide. Her stall is just west of here.
Will you fetch your sash and show it to me?
L1.started: Go, pup. Vikka's stall is just west of here.

piece.name: pup's digging sash
piece.description: A sash of tunnel-rat hide, knotted in clan Kolbok's way. Every pup of the Warrens wears one.

fetch.journal: Ask Stitcher Vikka, west of Elder Grikkis, for a pup's digging sash.
fetch.says: Grikkis sent you? Hold still, pup. There: hide for toughness, the clan's knot so we can find you by feel. No charge for a pup.

show.journal: Show the pup's digging sash to Elder Grikkis.
show.says: Good knot. Wear it, and no Kolbok will take you for a stray in the dark.

L2.name: Bound to the Warren
offer: Tunnels fall, pup, and the deep ways are long. Have Spiritmaster Kraaz bind your spirit to the warren, so that you wake here if the dark takes you.
Then give your name to Coachman Drekk for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
L2.declined: Then dig shallow until you do.
L2.started: Kraaz stands just east of here. Drekk keeps his stable to the south.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Kraaz, east of the elder, bind your spirit to the Warrens.
bind.says: It is done. Should the dark take you, you will wake here with the pack. Now go and give Coachman Drekk your name.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Drekk, south of the elder, for his ledger.
ledger.says: Welcome to my stable, pup. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

says: Good, good. Now every tunnel you dig leads back to us.
Drekk's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the deep ways to Klick'Anon are earned. Packleader Yarrk, beside me, has work for you.

L3.name: Beetles in the Props
offer: So you are the new pup. Good. Tunnel beetles have crawled in at the west end of the warren, where the walls give way to the hillside, and they chew our props.
Crack them and bring me three of their horns. Then I will teach you something worth knowing.
L3.declined: Then pray the props hold, pup.
L3.started: Three horns. Hit them where the shell is thin.

drop.name: tunnel beetle horn
drop.description: The horn of a tunnel beetle from the west end of the Warrens.

hunt.journal: Take three tunnel beetle horns from the tunnel beetles at the west end of the warren, on the hillside.

give.journal: Bring three tunnel beetle horns to Packleader Yarrk.
give.says: Three horns, and you still have both ears. You can fight. Now watch my paws, and learn this.

L4.name: A Pup's Arms
offer: Milk teeth will not serve you among the gnomes. I will make you proper gear, but you will fetch what I need.
Stitcher Vikka has hide lacing and a good shaft for me. Then take a leg from the deepway millipedes in the south tunnels.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then keep to your milk teeth, and to the nest.
L4.started: Lacing and a shaft from Vikka, a leg from the millipedes. Go.

items.name: rat-hide lacing
items.description: A long lace cut from tunnel-rat hide by the Warrens' stitchers.

materials.journal: Ask Stitcher Vikka for the rat-hide lacing and the wooden shaft.
materials.says: For Yarrk? Here, a lace of rat hide and a straight shaft. Tell him he owes me two fat beetles.

drop.name: deepway millipede leg
drop.description: A hard, jointed leg from a deepway millipede of the Warrens' south tunnels.

hunt.journal: Take a deepway millipede leg from the deepway millipedes in the passages south of the stalls.

give.journal: Bring the rat-hide lacing, the wooden shaft and the deepway millipede leg to Packleader Yarrk.
give.says: All three. Give me a moment... there. It is yours: do not chew on it.

L5.name: Gravelmaw
offer: One task more before the deep ways open for you. A great scythe beetle we call Gravelmaw has dug into the far chamber past the south tunnels, and two diggers have not come back.
It strikes first and it does not let go. Bring me its mandible, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a pup.
L5.declined: It will not grow smaller while you wait.
L5.started: South through the tunnels, past the millipedes, to the far chamber. Keep out of its scythes.

drop.name: Gravelmaw's mandible
drop.description: A notched mandible of the scythe beetle Gravelmaw.

hunt.journal: Take Gravelmaw's mandible from the scythe beetle Gravelmaw in the far chamber past the south tunnels.

give.journal: Bring Gravelmaw's mandible to Packleader Yarrk.
says: Gravelmaw's own mandible! Yip! The diggers can go south again. You are a pup no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Ruknar when you are ready for the deep ways.

flight.name: The Deep Ways
offer: The deep ways are clear to Tunaria. The gnomes of Klick'Anon pay well for our tunnel lore, and they will train you as their own.
You have earned the passage, pup. I will set you down among your own guild in Klick'Anon, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you through the deep ways?
flight.declined: The deep ways will wait for you.
flight.started: Mind your tail in the gnome city!
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Ruknar when you are ready to go through the deep ways to Klick'Anon.
